MATH 221 — Linear Algebra with Applications                        Page 1 of 3
Fall 2026 | Lectures TR 9:30-10:45 AM | Science Center 105
Instructor: Dr. Hannah Brooks | hbrooks@college.edu

Course Description
Systems of linear equations, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations,
eigenvalues and eigenvectors, orthogonality, and least squares, with applications.

Required Materials
Lay, Lay & McDonald, Linear Algebra and Its Applications, 6th ed.
WeBWorK online homework access (free through the course site).

Grading Policy
Online homework (WeBWorK) 15%, Written homework 15%, Quizzes 10%,
Exam 1 15%, Exam 2 15%, Final Exam 30%.
Grades: A 93-100, A- 90-92, B+ 87-89, B 83-86, B- 80-82, C+ 77-79, C 70-76, D 60-69.

Homework Policy
WeBWorK sets close every Sunday at 11:59 PM. Written homework is collected at the
start of lecture on the due date. The lowest written homework score is dropped.

Accommodations
Students with documented accommodations should contact the instructor during the
first two weeks of the term.
notes: Recurring weekly WeBWorK deadlines have no single date and are excluded.
